name: HAProxy
author: Netlens
description: Shows the backends of an HAProxy load balancer as sites: the first healthy server of each backend as the upstream (address and port), and whether the backend is in maintenance. HAProxy's statistics do not contain host names, so you can list them per backend yourself, otherwise the sites show without a domain. Netlens ties every backend to the device or container behind it. Read-only: it only reads the statistics page (CSV).

info.title: Switch on the statistics page
info.text: Add a statistics listener to haproxy.cfg, keep it on a private address and protect it with a user name and password. 'show-legends' makes HAProxy list each server's address, which Netlens needs.
info.code:
listen stats
    bind 192.168.0.4:8404
    stats enable
    stats uri /stats
    stats show-legends
    stats auth netlens:CHANGE-ME

columns.label: HAProxy host's own address
columns.help: The address of the machine HAProxy runs on, when the statistics are reached by name or as 127.0.0.1. Site checks are sent to it.

config.label: Host names per backend
config.help: Optional. Comma separated 'backend=host name' pairs (repeat a backend for several names). HAProxy does not tell Netlens which names reach which backend.
